clientOrderId.description: Unique order identifier as assigned by the trader.

timeInForce.description:
Order expiration mode.

Default:
* `type` is `"market"`, `"stopMarket"`, `"takeProfitMarket"`—`"FOK"`;
* `type` is `"limit"`, `"stopLimit"`, `"takeProfitLimit"`—`"GTC"`.

Values:
* *GTC* ("Good-Till-Canceled")—order will not be closed until it is filled.
* *IOC* ("Immediate-Or-Cancel")—order must be executed immediately. Any part of an IOC order that cannot be filled immediately will be canceled.
* *FOK* ("Fill-Or-Kill")—order must be executed immediately and completely or not executed at all.
* *Day*—keeps the order active until the end of the trading day (23:59 UTC+0).
* *GTD* ("Good-Till-Date")—order will be canceled on the specified date.

stopPrice.description: The price level that triggers order activation. Required if `"type"` is `stopLimit`, `stopMarket`, `takeProfitLimit`, or `takeProfitMarket`.

expireTime.description: Date of order expiration. Required if `"timeInForce"` is `GTD`.

strictValidate.description: Price and quantity will be checked for incrementation within the symbol’s tick size and quantity step.

postOnly.description:
A post-only order is an order that does not remove liquidity.
If the post-only order would cause a match with a pre-existing order as a taker, then the order will be canceled

closePosition.description:
Flag indicating a stop market order must close a margin position
 when executed or be canceled otherwise.

Conditions: `quantity` is omitted.

takeLiquidityMarkup.description: Additional fee charged from a taker for high-risk operations.

provideLiquidityMarkup.description: Additional fee charged from a maker for high-risk operations.
